problem:
Which of the following vector spaces has a dimension of $11?$

- ${R}_{10}[t]$, the vector space of all polynomials in the variable $t$ of degree at most $10$
- ${\text{M}}_{2\times 6}(R),$ the vector space of all $2\times 6$ matrices over $R$
- ${R}^{10}$
worked_solution:
Let's examine each of the vector spaces in turn.

- Recall that $\text{dim}({R}_{n}[t])=n+1.$ Therefore, 

$$
\text{dim}({R}_{10}[t])=10+1=11.\,✓
$$
- Recall that $\text{dim}({\text{M}}_{n\times m}(R))=n\cdot m.$ Therefore, 

$$
\text{dim}({\text{M}}_{2\times 6}(R))=2\cdot 6=12\ne 11.\,\times 
$$
- Recall that $\text{dim}({R}^{n})=n.$ Therefore, 

$$
\text{dim}({R}^{10})=10\ne 11.\,\times 
$$

Hence, the correct answer is "I only."
